# Private change record template

Copy this outside the public repository. Fields below are placeholders; no
actual environment, secret, endpoint, data or acceptance is included.

- Date and operator: TO RECORD PRIVATELY
- Need and observed current state: TO VERIFY
- Evidence source/date; design or declaration gaps: TO DISTINGUISH
- Destination/role and scope: PRIVATE INVENTORY REFERENCE
- Owner and exact proposed change: TO REVIEW
- Inputs/artifact revisions: PRIVATE FILE REFERENCES, NEVER SECRET VALUES
- Persistence affected and expected interruption: TO ASSESS
- Backup reference and most recent restore proof: TO VERIFY, NOT ASSUME
- Before/after and denied-flow checks: TO DEFINE
- Failure trigger and recovery steps: TO REVIEW
- Explicit authorization and its limits: TO RECORD
- Actual execution/check results: NOT EXECUTED
- Remaining unknowns and follow-up: TO RECORD

A completed document is not itself permission to deploy or publish. Keep raw
logs, real addresses, credentials and private evidence in protected storage.
